## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (4)
- `GET /api/v2/cookie_sent` — Check if cookie has been sent during authentication flow.
- `GET /api/v2/session/touch_track` — Update session activity tracking.
- `GET /upfunnel/experiments/{experimentToken}` — Retrieve experiment configuration using an experiment token.
- `POST /account/api/auth/getAuthRedirectUrl` — Get the redirect URL for authentication.

### Data Read (9)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data by ID.
- `GET /action/0` — Get action data.
- `GET /api/public/v1/analytics/{analyticId}` — Retrieve analytics data by ID.
- `GET /p/conversions/s/0.8.53` — Get conversion data (versioned).
- `GET /p/conversions/t/{tId}` — Retrieve conversion data by ID.
- `GET /scripts/cookiebar/{cookiebarId}` — Get cookie bar content by its ID.
- `GET /userapi/{userapiId}/` — Retrieve user-related data by user API ID.
- `GET /userapi/payment/{paymentId}/` — Retrieve payment information by payment ID.
- `POST /checkout/api/Cart/GetCart` — Retrieve cart details.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /actionp/0` — Post action data.
- `POST /p/conversions/c/{cId}` — Record conversion data by ID.
- `POST /v1/{v1Id}` — Post data to a specific endpoint.

### Config (3)
- `GET /{id}/api/gateway/getAppConfig` — Fetch application configuration by ID.
- `GET /checkout/api/gateway/getAppLaunchConfig` — Get configuration for launching the checkout application.
- `GET /v1/config/{configHash}` — Fetch application configuration using a config hash.
